Additionally, the screen reason (bull side) indicates that profit growth exceeds 20% YoY [E69], which directly contradicts the bear’s claim of decelerating earnings. The company's strong asset values, historical sales growth, and recent outperformance outweigh the short-term negative indicators cited by the bear.
